reason: A more directly tests atmosphere-dependent selective oxidation against the as-built baseline and provides a clearer falsification criterion, although its prediction of greater internal oxidation under strongly reducing conditions and the assumed protectiveness of Ti-rich oxides require refinement. B relies on unsupported Cr/Al surface segregation and dealloying claims, invokes cyclic spallation without specifying a cyclic experiment, and cites evidence from compositionally and structurally dissimilar refractory alloys.
